latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of env-manager.

- Secure storage of environment variables and secrets with AES-256 encryption at rest
- Support for multiple environment profiles (dev, staging, production)
- Automatic loading of environment configuration at session start
- Credential rotation reminders and tools to track last rotation date
- Audit log to monitor secret access
- Security best practices guidance included
- Suggestion for team credential sharing via ClawSwarm integration
